scope: Static study of the five highest-ranked publicly accessible finished/didnt_qualify agents in the saved competition-28 leaderboard snapshot. Public agents were parsed, not imported or executed.
limitations: The absolute top five returned HTTP 403; their implementations could not be inspected.
Many source definitions are identical between references. This is correlated evidence, not five independent experiments.
Source patterns do not prove which features caused screening success.
Production tracebacks for Quarry are unavailable in the public response. Neither local reproduction proves the production root cause.
Peer evaluation details were retrieved for Adidas. An additional Aurora metrics request returned HTTP 403, so no missing peer screening metrics are inferred.
Screening scores and final three-validator consensus scores use different stages and must not be compared as the same metric.

findings.topic: Distinguish temporary reservations from a hard budget cap
findings.evidence: Aurora:635, Adidas:563, ChatGPT:2035, and Emerge victory:2042 special-case HTTP 402 in_flight_budget_exhausted with bounded waiting. Enigma lacks that special case. Quarry wallet.py:191 treats every HTTP 402 as terminal.
findings.confirmed_local: budget-probe.json: one temporary reservation response ends the call, marks the wallet spent, and never reaches the prepared successful response.
findings.hypothesis: A production proxy reservation response could end a run before its first patch. Actual occurrence in the failed screening is unknown.
findings.experiment: Inject temporary reservation then success, repeated temporary reservation, genuine cap exhaustion, and Retry-After beyond the remaining deadline; preserve unknown-cost accounting.

findings.evidence: Aurora agent.py:406 reads with an absolute deadline and agent.py:6836 adds an outer stop. Quarry llm.py:115 uses a socket timeout followed by full response.read().
findings.confirmed_local: timeout-probe.json: a 0.1-second requested timeout returned after 0.636 seconds while bytes arrived every 0.03 seconds.
findings.experiment: Bound response bodies, HTTP error bodies, tool processes and finalization by one monotonic deadline. Test a trickling response, a stalled response and cleanup near expiry.

findings.evidence: All five references inspect edit progress and nudge toward a first change; Aurora agent.py:6606 and Enigma agent.py:7628 are examples. Aurora optional read-tool withholding is disabled by default. Quarry loop.py has no edit-progress trigger or dedicated first-patch recovery phase.
findings.experiment: Measure time and spend before the first applicable in-scope patch, repeated read calls, finish attempts on unchanged trees, and rejection reasons. Reserve bounded recovery capacity without forcing irrelevant edits.

findings.topic: Recognize truncation and retain usable work
findings.evidence: Aurora agent.py:733 detects an empty length-truncated completion and its request loop handles it. ChatGPT agent.py:8239 retries an empty derivation when budget allows and preserves applicable alternatives. Quarry has candidate ranking and handoff checks already, but llm.py does not retain finish_reason.
findings.experiment: Inject length-truncated responses, errors after useful edits, failed whole-patch apply checks and handoff exceptions. Retain applicable full patches; never count an empty or irrelevant diff as a success.

findings.evidence: v003 local evidence contains seven distinct tasks repeated three times, and all 21 runtime logs show cap_usd=0.29. The cap value was not missing locally. Local G7 required 50% solve rate. Production performance cannot be inferred from that local gate.
findings.experiment: Build broader independent repository tasks, retain an untouched holdout, run paired repetitions against frozen v003, and report per-task solve consistency, no-patch failures, total/p95 cost and time. Verify environment differences explicitly.

proposed_order: Record stop reasons and first-patch time/spend before tuning.
Add failing offline regressions for temporary reservations and total response deadlines; implement original fixes and prove both pass.
Add bounded no-patch recovery and test patch preservation.
Compare one behavioral change at a time on broader frozen tasks using the existing paired confirmation protocol.
Only then compare model/reasoning/output-limit configurations under identical caps.
Review an exact frozen bundle with full evidence and current competition criteria before another paid upload.

validation.v003_originality_check: PASS against 14 references; highest distinctive-line overlap 1.4%, highest token-shingle overlap 1.2%
